 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. NASHVILLE —  Alabama football's final injury report is out ahead of the Vanderbilt game, and quarterback Keelon Russell is a game-time decision
 Russell (ankle) was one of two players listed as a game-time decision, along with defensive back Chuck McDonald III. Running back EJ Crowell, defensive back Zabien Brown and offensive lineman William Sanders were not listed on the final availability report.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Russell is not expected to start against the Commodores , but is expected to be available if needed. Austin Mack is expected to get his first Alabama start against Vanderbilt.
 No new players were listed as out ahead of Alabama vs. Vanderbilt.
 Alabama kicks off against Vanderbilt at 11:45 a.m. CT, Saturday, Nov. 14, on SEC Network.
